summary: AI-native hiring platform that turns a role brief into sourced, engaged, interview-ready candidates.
editor_note: The sharper bet is to sell completed recruiting work, not another ATS seat. Metix pairs agent-run briefing, search, engagement, and scheduling across a stated 860M+ profiles with delivery-lead quality review and outcome-based pricing. Unlike sourcing copilots that hand recruiters another queue, it is accountable for interview-ready candidates. The open question is whether the human layer can shrink as volume grows or each customer stays service-heavy.
investors: Rsquared Investment, LongRiver Investments, Fengshion Capital

product_evidence.claim: The official demo exposes a four-step hiring walkthrough from role definition through sample review, candidate outreach, and completion without requiring an account.
The official pricing page ties each credit to an interested, hire-ready candidate, waives the credit when a candidate is not worth meeting, and offers a 14-day trial without a card.

The official company overview says Mira turns a role brief into search, engagement, and booked interviews across a stated 860M+ profiles, with customer approval before outreach and delivery-lead quality review.
The funding announcement describes sourcing, outreach, screening, and scheduling across a global talent network, followed by delivery-team review before the shortlist reaches the customer.

market_context.primary_user: Founders without internal recruiting capacity and talent-acquisition teams overloaded by sourcing.
market_context.differentiation: Metix combines agent-run sourcing, outreach, screening, and scheduling with human shortlist review, then charges for interview-ready candidates instead of software access or recruiter hours.
market_context.why_now: The latest $3M Seed+ follows a $2.5M Seed within six months, funding deeper automation and North American expansion as vertical AI agents move from workflow assistance toward accountable outcome delivery.

risks.claim: If delivery-team hours do not fall per qualified interview as customer volume grows, gross margins and software-like scalability will remain constrained.
risks.basis: The official funding announcement says people review every shortlist and that part of the new funding will expand the delivery team.

risks.claim: The $5.5M headline is cumulative across two rounds, so treating it as the latest round would overstate this financing event.
risks.basis: The official announcement separates an earlier $2.5M Seed from the latest $3M round; the July 6 release identifies that latest round as Seed+.
